title: Optimal Equivariant Matchings on the 6-Cube with an Application to the King Wen Sequence
summary: We study equivariant perfect matchings on the Boolean hypercube $\B^6$ under the Klein four-group $K_4 = \langle \comp, \rev \rangle$ generated by bitwise complement and reversal. Among matchings using only $\comp$ or $\rev$ pairings, there is a unique Hamming-cost minimizer, given by a simple ``reverse-priority rule'': pair each element with its reversal unless it is a palindrome, in which case pair it with its complement.
